scope: Optional saved-result publication in local macOS x86_64 generated apps; straight-line and positive saturating-exponential models

reuse.decision: Extend the existing Matplotlib adapter with subplots and inert saved SciPy results. No replacement renderer or solver.

behaviors: Explicit choice of data-only or saved-fit content; independent Mathtext PDF/SVG/PNG or LaTeX PDF choice
Current data node and specification hash select the exact saved result; export does not refit
Stored curve, raw residual panel, parameter estimates and approximate standard errors
Full covariance, statistics, solver versions and result/source hashes in fit-report.json
Newer unfinished or failed matching attempt, disabled fitting, malformed result and changed data refuse fit export
Later edits do not change frozen source and results
Ordinary error/cancellation removes incomplete new bundles; existing destinations protected
Export identity and outcome persist after explicit save/reopen; data restoration does not delete external files

fitted_export.includes: Real weighted line and nonlinear LaTeX render, exact artist coordinates, hashes, stale input, failure and cancellation

rendered_review.pdfs: Both complete example PDFs rasterized with Poppler and visually inspected; no clipping or overlap observed
rendered_review.coordinates: Matplotlib artist x/y values equal stored curves and residuals for both examples

runtime_parity: Final generated instance has identical application runtime to the passing combined-host runs. The common host test subsequently adds focus immediately before native undo/redo; publication-only host verifies that test correction.
limitations: No GUM or Monte Carlo propagation, coverage or prediction intervals
Exact x; unweighted or absolute independent y-sigma fits only
No physical printer control, arbitrary figure design or interactive plot fidelity guarantee
External Python/Matplotlib and optional TeX dependencies; other operating systems not qualified
Native save-dialog completion not automated; host tests supply an explicit destination
Cold macOS font discovery can reach the 90-second renderer timeout; incomplete output is removed, no performance guarantee
Forced-crash recovery and general power-loss durability remain excluded
No packaged or signed fitted-publication application built
qualification_notes: Combined and publication-only attempts encountered the pre-existing text undo focus issue. The common test now refocuses immediately before native undo/redo; the application runtime is unchanged.
A compiled-host attempt timed out while macOS system_profiler enumerated fonts during concurrent rendering checks; incomplete output was removed. Subsequent qualification ran alone.
Compiled-host pointer automation stalled waiting for quick-pick stability; the visible choices were subsequently exercised with keyboard selection.
Historical template 0.3/0.4 qualification records retain their original scope and source hashes.
